name: Korea Projection: Wireless for Korean Cars (without NEMESIS)
description: Korea Projection's NEMESIS package run as an HMG-API mod, for a head unit without NEMESIS: hmgapid runs the hotspot service (svc/hotspot.sh) as root, installs the status app, and starts the status script when the app opens. Tucson NX4 (Korea, 260902) only.
